title: Refund cancelled bookings
statementMd:
Delete bookings for cancelled flights, then report the total fare of the remaining bookings rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `remaining_fare`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `DELETE FROM bookings WHERE flight_id IN (SELECT id FROM flights WHERE status = 'cancelled')`.
solutionMd:
```sql
DELETE FROM bookings WHERE flight_id IN (SELECT id FROM flights WHERE status = 'cancelled'); SELECT ROUND(SUM(fare), 2) AS remaining_fare FROM bookings;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
